meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 装上后，当你想回顾一个项目的开发过程时，Claude 会从 claude-mem 的持久记忆中拉取完整时间线，生成一份名为「Journey Into [项目名]」的叙事报告，覆盖项目起源、架构演变、关键突破、技术债、Token 经济学等十部分，并保存为 Markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求写时间线报告、分析项目历史、总结开发历程等时触发；需要 claude-mem worker 在运行且项目已有观测记录。

say.text: 给当前项目写一份 Journey Into 报告
say.note: Claude 会先报 token 估算并征求确认

say.text: 分析 tokyo 项目的完整开发历史
say.note: 会拉取该项目全部观测记录，生成叙事报告

say.text: 总结这个项目的开发历程和关键转折点
say.note: 报告含起源、架构演变、技术债等章节

howto.what_en: Claude fetches the full timeline from claude-mem's persistent memory and writes a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report covering ten sections (genesis, architecture, breakthroughs, debt, token economics, etc.), saved as Markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a timeline report, project history analysis, or development journey; requires claude-mem worker running and observations recorded for the project.

say_en.text: Write a Journey Into report for the current project
say_en.note: Claude reports token estimate and asks confirmation first.

say_en.text: Analyze the full development history of the tokyo project
say_en.note: Fetches all project data and writes a narrative report.

say_en.text: Summarize this project's development journey and key turning points
say_en.note: Covers genesis, architecture, technical debt, etc.
